title: pr-self-review batch result
description: What one reviewer subagent writes to <run>/findings/<batch-id>.json.

batch.description: Batch id from plan.json, e.g. onion-architecture--1

filesReviewed.description: Every file of the batch, repo-relative. A batch file missing here makes the verdict incomplete.

line.description: 1-based line in the working-tree file; 0 if file-level

rule.description: Short kebab-case id of the skill rule broken, e.g. core-no-infra, rules-of-hooks

evidence.description: The offending code (quoted) and why it matches the rule

fix.description: The concrete change that resolves it

introduced.description: true if this diff creates the problem; false if it predates the diff
